brief:
Ofer Cassif, a member of the Israeli Knesset, accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his allies of using scapegoating tactics regarding Arab voter turnout, Middle East Eye reported. Cassif, a Palestinian lawmaker, suggested that Netanyahu's framing of the issue reflected broader political strategy rather than genuine concern about electoral participation.

The comments reflect tensions over Arab representation and participation in Israeli elections, a recurring point of friction in Israeli political discourse.

title: Palestinian lawmaker says Netanyahu scapegoats Arab voters
